Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full digital insurance ID card payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Proof of insurance","carrier":"Meridian Mutual","policyType":"Auto","policyholder":"Jordan Rivera","policyNumber":"AUTO-8842-XY","vehicle":"2022 Tesla Model 3","plate":"8ABC123","effectiveDate":"Jan 1, 2026","expirationDate":"Jul 1, 2028","status":"Active","coverages":[{"label":"Liability"},{"label":"Collision","detail":"$500 ded."},{"label":"Comprehensive","detail":"$500 ded."},{"label":"Uninsured motorist"}],"submitText":"Email me a copy","submitValue":"Email me a copy of my insurance ID card","secondaryText":"Add to wallet"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): eyebrow above the card. Defaults to 'Proof of insurance'. - 'carrier' (string, recommended): the insurer / brand name shown on the card. - 'policyType' (string, optional): line of business, e.g. 'Auto' or 'Home'; rendered as '<policyType> · ID Card'. - 'policyholder','policyNumber','vehicle','plate','effectiveDate','expirationDate' (strings, optional): shown in the card's detail grid. 'policyNumber' and 'plate' render in monospace. Include the ones that apply to the policy type ('vehicle'/'plate' for auto; omit them for other lines). - 'status' (string, optional): e.g. 'Active' or 'Lapsed'; rendered as a pill. - 'coverages' (array, optional): each item MUST have 'label' (string) and MAY have 'detail' (string, e.g. '$500 ded.'). Shown as chips under the details. - 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label; defaults to 'Email me a copy'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the EXACT message sent back to the agent when the primary button is tapped; defaults to a sensible 'Email me a copy...' phrase. - 'secondaryText' (string, optional): a ghost secondary button label, e.g. 'Add to wallet'. This card is administrative proof-of-insurance only — never include data beyond what a physical insurance ID card shows. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
